facts.title: Colorful Beet Salad with Carrot, Quinoa & Spinach
ingredients: ⅓ cup slivered almonds or pepitas (green pumpkin seeds)
1 medium-to-large carrot (or 1 additional medium beet), peeled
2 cups packed baby spinach or arugula, roughly chopped
1 tablespoon chopped fresh mint or cilantro
2 tablespoons honey or maple syrup or agave nectar
½ to 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard, to taste
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
